youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的機上入眠情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從登機時選走道還是窗邊、跟空服員要眼罩與耳塞、調椅背和腳踏板、脫鞋換厚襪、晚餐托盤來了要不要、關燈後戴上耳機聽雨聲、半夜半夢半醒去洗手間、腳腫了猛喝水與拉筋、備好時差藥，一直到落地前被輕輕搖醒、喝到溫熱的咖啡、看見風車與綠色的田，不用背，睡前聽就會。整段紅眼航班共十三個小時，晚十一點半起飛、早上六點半落地、當地時間往回六小時。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish

This video features practical Getting Sleep on a Night Flight phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — two travel companions board a thirteen hour red-eye: choose aisle or window, ask the crew for an eye mask and foam earplugs, work the recline button and the footrest, decide whether to eat the dinner tray, dim the cabin and put on earphones for rain sounds, stumble to the lavatory half asleep, drink water for swollen feet and stretch at the seat, plan the jet lag pill, and get gently woken before touchdown with warm coffee and windmills outside the window. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are on the plane at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ɑn ðə pleɪn æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 我們總算上飛機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and nearly every seat is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ˈnɪrli ˈɛvri sit ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，幾乎每個座位都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our row is twenty-three, near the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr roʊ ɪz ˈtwɛnti θri nɪr ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我們那排是二十三排，靠近後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the back rows board last.
dialogue.zh: 剛好，後面的座位最後上機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, twenty-three A is the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ˈtwɛnti θri eɪ ɪz ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，二十三 A 是靠窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And C is the aisle, that is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd si ɪz ði ˈaɪl ðæt ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: C 就是走道側，那個是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who has the middle seat, then?
dialogue.zh: 那中間的座位是誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody, that seat is empty.
dialogue.zh: 沒人坐，那個位子是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky us, three seats for two people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ʌs θri sits fɔr tu ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 我們運氣真好，兩個人有三個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I can stretch my legs there.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn strɛtʃ maɪ lɛɡz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那我可以在那裡把腿伸直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do you want my window seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, du ju wɑnt maɪ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ sit?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你想要我那格靠窗的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the aisle lets me stretch out.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ði ˈaɪl lɛts mi strɛtʃ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，走道側讓我可以把腿伸開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I get up a lot, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ ɡɛt ʌp ə lɑt, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可是我半夜會一直起來，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the empty middle helps you.
dialogue.zh: 那中間那個空位就是在幫你啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Helps? Tell me how that works.
dialogue.zh: 幫我？那是怎麼幫的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You climb over one, not two.
dialogue.zh: 你只要跨過一個人，不用跨兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you are right. Good point.
dialogue.zh: 噢，你說得對，好主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So keep the window, lean and sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kip ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ, lin ænd slip./
dialogue.zh: 那就繼續坐窗邊，靠著睡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That man wants to swap with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt mæn wɑnts tə swɑp wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 那個先生想跟我們換位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why? He has a good seat too.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ hi hæz ə ɡʊd sit tu./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？他的位子也不差啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His daughter sits two rows away.
dialogue.zh: 他女兒坐在隔兩排的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, poor kid. Which one does he want?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ pʊr kɪd wɪtʃ wʌn dʌz hi wɑnt?/
dialogue.zh: 噢，可憐的孩子。他想換哪個位子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asks for the window, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æsks fɔr ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想他要的是靠窗那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, but that is your seat, not mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm, bʌt ðæt ɪz jɔr sit, nɑt maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，可那是你的位子，又不是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He can take the empty middle.
dialogue.zh: 他可以坐中間那個空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we keep our seats? Great.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們不用換？太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says thank you and moves ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz θæŋk ju ænd muvz əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 他跟我們道謝，往前走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Nobody lost a seat tonight.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，今晚沒人少到位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag will not fit the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ wɪl nɑt fɪt ðə bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我的包塞不進行李架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it sideways, the bins fill fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt ˈsaɪdˌweɪz ðə bɪnz fɪl fæst./
dialogue.zh: 橫著放試試，架子一下子就滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No room left, not one empty slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rum lɛft nɑt wʌn ˈɛmti slɑt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有位置了，連一個空的都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then put it under the seat.
dialogue.zh: 那就放在座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under mine or under yours?
dialogue.zh: 放我下面還是你下面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under mine, yours is the bigger bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər maɪn jʊrz ɪz ðə ˈbɪɡər bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 放我下面，你那個包比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop goes inside my coat pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑp ɡoʊz ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ koʊt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的筆電放進外套口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, keep it close while you sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt kip ɪt kloʊs waɪl ju slip./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，睡著時也帶在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take off your coat, it is warm in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɔf jɔr koʊt ɪt ɪz wɔrm ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 外套脫了吧，裡面好熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use mine as a pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl juz maɪn æz ə ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我打算把我的外套當枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my neck pillow, look.
dialogue.zh: 我的頸枕拿出來了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soft one or the puffy one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔft wʌn ɔr ðə ˈpʌfi wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 是軟的那個還是鼓的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Puffy, then. My neck gets stiff.
dialogue.zh: 那就選鼓的那個，我脖子容易僵硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine folds flat, it fits my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn foʊldz flæt ɪt fɪts maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我那個可以折平，收進口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the thick socks?
dialogue.zh: 你有帶厚襪子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs, one pair for the plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz wʌn pɛr fɔr ðə pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 帶了兩雙，一雙專程搭飛機用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, the floor here is always cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðə flɔr hɪr ɪz ˈɔlˌweɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，飛機地板總是冰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And my feet swell on long flights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ fit swɛl ɑn lɔŋ flaɪts./
dialogue.zh: 而且我長途飛行腳會腫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buckle up, they want us seated now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌkəl ʌp ðeɪ wɑnt ʌs ˈsitɪd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 先繫好，他們要我們坐定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The belt feels tight over my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt filz taɪt ˈoʊvər maɪ koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 安全帶壓在外套上，有點緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the coat flat, like this.
dialogue.zh: 把外套折平，像這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, now the belt sits lower.
dialogue.zh: 啊，現在安全帶低多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We move now, look outside.
dialogue.zh: 我們開始動了，看外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take off at eleven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 我們十一點半起飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours in the air tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚要在空中飛十三個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirteen! Then I must really sleep.
dialogue.zh: 十三小時！那我非睡不可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We land at six thirty in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lænd æt sɪks ˈθɜrti ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們早上六點半落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty, so I have one job.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜrti soʊ aɪ hæv wʌn dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 六點半，所以我只有一件事要做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which is to sleep the whole way.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ɪz tə slip ðə hoʊl weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那就是一路睡到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and Amsterdam is six hours behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ˈæmstrədəm ɪz sɪks ˈaʊərz bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 對，阿姆斯特丹的時間還晚六小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hours back, my head hurts already.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈaʊərz bæk maɪ hɛd hɜrts ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 往回六小時，我頭已經開始痛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep fixes it, so no wine tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈfɪksəz ɪt soʊ noʊ waɪn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 睡一睡就會好，所以今晚不喝酒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the lights by the door dimmed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə laɪts baɪ ðə dɔr dɪmd./
dialogue.zh: 你看，門口那邊的燈剛剛變暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that means the crew is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt minz ðə kru ɪz ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 很好，代表空服員準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need something for my eyes.
dialogue.zh: 我需要一個蓋眼睛的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An eye mask? Ask the lady there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən aɪ mæsk æsk ðə ˈleɪdi ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 眼罩嗎？去問那邊那位小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which lady? The one by the cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈleɪdi? ðə wʌn baɪ ðə kɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 哪位小姐？推車旁邊那一位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her, she is bringing masks out.
dialogue.zh: 就是她，她正在把眼罩拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, your elbow is on my side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl jɔr ˈɛlboʊ ɪz ɑn maɪ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 小心點，你的手肘壓到我這邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, this armrest is stuck down.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，這個扶手卡在最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can share it, half and half.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn ʃɛr ɪt hæf ænd hæf./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以共用，一半給你一半給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, elbows on your half.
dialogue.zh: 很公道，你的手肘放你那半邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see the wing from there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ðə wɪŋ frʌm ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你從那裡看得到機翼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a small piece of it.
dialogue.zh: 只看得到一小角而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our row sits right by the engine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊr roʊ sɪts raɪt baɪ ði ˈɛndʒən./
dialogue.zh: 我們這排剛好就在引擎旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hear it, but it stays low.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hɪr ɪt bʌt ɪt steɪz loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 聽得到，不過聲音一直很低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A low hum helps me sleep faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə loʊ hʌm hɛlps mi slip ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 低低的轟鳴聲反而讓我睡得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? I hear every small cough.
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？每一聲輕咳我都聽見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone behind us is already snoring.
dialogue.zh: 我們後面已經有人在打呼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before we leave the ground? Wonderful.
dialogue.zh: 還沒離地就開始？太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked for legroom, but no luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt fɔr ˈlɛɡˌrʊm bʌt noʊ lʌk./
dialogue.zh: 我想要多點腿部空間，但沒排到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three is fine, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 二十三排也不差啦，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This seat pocket has a magazine.
dialogue.zh: 椅背袋裡有一本雜誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will read ten pages, then sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rɛd tɛn ˈpeɪdʒəz ðɛn slip./
dialogue.zh: 我先讀十頁，然後就睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the safety card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt ðə ˈseɪfti kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 安全須知卡被你放哪兒了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stayed in the seat pocket.
dialogue.zh: 它還留在椅背袋裡呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the gate is dropping back.
dialogue.zh: 你看，登機口已經往後退了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have the window, enjoy the show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你有靠窗，好好欣賞吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Runway lights are sliding past us.
dialogue.zh: 跑道燈一盞盞從旁邊滑過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit back and let me count hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt bæk ænd lɛt mi kaʊnt ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 靠好，讓我算還剩幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is eleven forty, we are climbing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈlɛvən ˈfɔrti wi ɑr ˈklaɪmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在十一點四十，正在爬升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost thirteen hours till the morning.
dialogue.zh: 差不多十三個小時才到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your seat belt loose or tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jɔr sit bɛlt lus ɔr taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你的安全帶是鬆的還是緊的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose, so I can turn at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus soʊ aɪ kæn tɜrn æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鬆一點，半夜才好翻身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still on, the seatbelt light.
dialogue.zh: 還亮著呢，繫安全帶那盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no getting up for a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ˈɡɛtɪŋ ʌp fɔr ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 那我們一時間別想起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck pillow is already on.
dialogue.zh: 我的頸枕已經戴好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will borrow your shoulder first.
dialogue.zh: 我先跟你借一下肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, but do not drool on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr bʌt du nɑt drul ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，但別流口水在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never! I will use my own sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər aɪ wɪl juz maɪ oʊn sliv./
dialogue.zh: 才不會！我用我自己的袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here she comes, a flight attendant.
dialogue.zh: 她走過來了，一位空服員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her for a soft eye mask.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr fɔr ə sɔft aɪ mæsk./
dialogue.zh: 去跟她要一個軟軟的眼罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, may I ask a quick thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, meɪ aɪ æsk ə kwɪk θɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我可以問個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She nods, she heard you fine.
dialogue.zh: 她點頭，她聽得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have an eye mask for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ən aɪ mæsk fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有眼罩可以給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has a whole box, look.
dialogue.zh: 她有一整盒呢，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two masks, one for you as well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mæskz, wʌn fɔr ju æz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 兩個眼罩，你也有是一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, the soft kind or the hard kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ðə sɔft kaɪnd ɔr ðə hɑrd kaɪnd?/
dialogue.zh: 好耶，是軟的還是硬的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft, with a little nose bump.
dialogue.zh: 軟的，鼻子那邊有一點凸起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bump keeps my glasses safe.
dialogue.zh: 有凸起我的眼鏡才不會被壓到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine has a thin string band.
dialogue.zh: 我這個是很細的繩子帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The band pulls my hair, ugh.
dialogue.zh: 那條帶子會扯到我的頭髮，唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it on backwards, over the ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn ˈbækwərdz, ˈoʊvər ði ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 把它反過來戴，壓在耳朵上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that stops the pulling too.
dialogue.zh: 噢，這樣就不會扯頭髮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says these block all the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz, ðiz blɑk ɔl ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她說這種可以把光全擋掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my eyelids are too thin.
dialogue.zh: 正好，我的眼皮本來就很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it loose enough for you?
dialogue.zh: 你戴起來夠鬆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug, but I can still blink.
dialogue.zh: 剛剛好，不過我還是能眨眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have earplugs too?
dialogue.zh: 他們也有耳塞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the soft foam kind, look.
dialogue.zh: 有，軟海綿那種，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do these small things work?
dialogue.zh: 這種小東西怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You roll one thin, then push it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju roʊl wʌn θɪn, ðɛn pʊʃ ɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 先把它搓細，再塞進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It grows back inside my ear.
dialogue.zh: 它會在耳朵裡慢慢膨起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the loud hum goes away.
dialogue.zh: 然後那個吵轟鳴就消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine are in too deep now.
dialogue.zh: 我的塞得太深了現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look calm. Do you hear me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk kɑm. du ju hɪr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你看起來很安靜，你聽得到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear you, just very far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ju, dʒʌst ˈvɛri fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 聽得到，只是像從很遠的地方傳來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that is what I want.
dialogue.zh: 完美，那就是我要的效果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She gave us one extra pair.
dialogue.zh: 她多給了我們一副。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take both, I sleep with one ear free.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk boʊθ, aɪ slip wɪð wʌn ɪr fri./
dialogue.zh: 兩個都拿去，我留一隻耳朵空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, so you can hear the call.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, soʊ ju kæn hɪr ðə kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣廣播你聽得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The call for what? Dinner, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 叫什麼？可能是要發晚餐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they serve dinner tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚飛機上要供應晚餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In one hour, she just told me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn wʌn ˈaʊər, ʃi dʒʌst toʊld mi./
dialogue.zh: 一小時後，她剛剛跟我說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And breakfast before we land?
dialogue.zh: 那落地前有早餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right after the lights come on.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, raɪt ˈæftər ðə laɪts kʌm ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 有，開燈之後就送上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask her for one more blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk hɜr fɔr wʌn mɔr ˈblæŋkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再跟她要一條毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one is thin as paper, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ɪz θɪn æz ˈpeɪpər, jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 這條薄得像紙，快去要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blankets make a real bed.
dialogue.zh: 兩條毯子才像真的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says the second one is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə ˈsɛkənd wʌn ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她說第二條馬上送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lower back needs support too.
dialogue.zh: 我的下背也需要東西撐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for a pillow for your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr ə ˈpɪloʊ fɔr jɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 就跟她要一個靠背的枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She brought a small warm towel.
dialogue.zh: 她拿來一條溫熱的小毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that feels so good on my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðæt filz soʊ ɡʊd ɑn maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 噢，放在脖子上好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take yours before it cools.
dialogue.zh: 給，你先拿去，不然就涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You first, I have my wet wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fɜrst, aɪ hæv maɪ wɛt waɪp./
dialogue.zh: 你先，我有一片濕紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipes for my hands, clever you.
dialogue.zh: 還有擦手的濕紙巾，你真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one for my face, too.
dialogue.zh: 另外留一張擦臉用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a kit with a toothbrush?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə kɪt wɪð ə ˈtuθˌbrʌʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有那種附牙刷的小包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She points to the front, one each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pɔɪnts tə ðə frʌnt, wʌn itʃ./
dialogue.zh: 她指前面，說一人一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small bag with toothpaste inside.
dialogue.zh: 小小一包，裡面有牙膏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for when we land tired.
dialogue.zh: 落地時累呆呆的剛好有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asks if we want water now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æsks ɪf wi wɑnt ˈwɔtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她問我們現在要不要喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes please, two cups, no ice.
dialogue.zh: 要，兩杯水，不要加冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No ice, so nothing spills on us.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪs, soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ spɪlz ɑn ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 不加冰，就不會灑在我們身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and a small cup spills less.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ænd ə smɔl kʌp spɪlz lɛs./
dialogue.zh: 對啊，杯子小比較不容易灑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small cup will not last all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl kʌp wɪl nɑt læst ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一小杯水撐不了一整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says more water comes at breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz mɔr ˈwɔtər kʌmz æt ˈbrɛkfəst./
dialogue.zh: 她說早餐時還會再送水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my mouth dries up fast here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, maɪ maʊθ draɪz ʌp fæst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我在飛機上嘴很容易乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The air is so dry, right?
dialogue.zh: 空氣超乾的，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask her about the light over us.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr əˈbaʊt ðə laɪt ˈoʊvər ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 問問我們頭頂上那盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can dim our side, she says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn dɪm ˈɑʊr saɪd, ʃi sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 她說可以把我們這側調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we can sleep in real dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn slip ɪn ril dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就能睡在真正的黑暗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real dark, with the mask on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril dɑrk, wɪð ðə mæsk ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 真的黑，再加個眼罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her name tag says Mei, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr neɪm tæɡ sɛz meɪ, baɪ ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對了，她的名牌寫著小美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, Mei brought us the towels.
dialogue.zh: 人真好，毛巾就是她拿來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she say when she wakes us?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi seɪ wɛn ʃi weɪks ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 她說幾點會叫我們起床了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says she will shake us gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ʃi wɪl ʃeɪk ʌs ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 她說會輕輕搖醒我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gently is kind, I sleep so hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntli ɪz kaɪnd, aɪ slip soʊ hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖真好，我睡得很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do not set a phone alarm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn du nɑt sɛt ə foʊn əˈlɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 那你就別設手機鬧鐘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No alarm, no watch, just sleep.
dialogue.zh: 不設鬧鐘，不看時間，專心睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My watch still says Taipei time.
dialogue.zh: 我的手錶還是台北的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hours behind, do not forget.
dialogue.zh: 那邊晚六小時，別忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will forget everything once I sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl fərˈɡɛt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wʌns aɪ slip./
dialogue.zh: 我一睡下去就什麼都忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the man behind get his mask?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə mæn bɪˈhaɪnd ɡɛt hɪz mæsk?/
dialogue.zh: 後面那位先生拿到眼罩了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and a pillow for his knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ə ˈpɪloʊ fɔr hɪz niz./
dialogue.zh: 拿到了，還多一個墊膝蓋的枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That baby up front is quiet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈbeɪbi ʌp frʌnt ɪz ˈkwaɪət naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 前面那個嬰兒現在安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She walked her up and down the aisle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɔkt hɜr ʌp ænd daʊn ði ˈaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 她媽抱著她在走道來回走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor lady, that is hard work.
dialogue.zh: 那位媽媽真辛苦，抱著走很累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She smiled at us, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過她還是對我們笑了笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this mask fit over your glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs mæsk fɪt ˈoʊvər jɔr ˈɡlæsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 這個眼罩蓋得住你的眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take them off before I sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðɛm ɔf bɪˈfɔr aɪ slip./
dialogue.zh: 我睡之前會先把眼鏡摘下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them in the hard case, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm ɪn ðə hɑrd keɪs, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請把眼鏡放進硬盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already done, it fits in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi dʌn, ɪt fɪts ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 早就收好了，塞進口袋剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked if we need more air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt ɪf wi nid mɔr ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 她問我們需不需要多一點風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I said yes, my face feels hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛd jɛs, maɪ feɪs filz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我說要，我的臉覺得好熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which little fan? The one above us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈlɪtəl fæn? ðə wʌn əˈbʌv ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個小風扇？我們頭上那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She turns it down for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 她說今晚幫我們把風轉小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you have everything for sleep?
dialogue.zh: 現在睡覺要的東西都齊了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mask, plugs, blankets, water. Almost.
dialogue.zh: 眼罩、耳塞、毯子、水。還差一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is missing, your neck thing?
dialogue.zh: 還缺什麼，你的頸枕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the seat itself is the problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə sit ɪtˈsɛlf ɪz ðə ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 不，問題是這個位子本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too straight? Mine is too straight.
dialogue.zh: 太直了嗎？我這個也太直。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stands up like a classroom chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stændz ʌp laɪk ə ˈklæsˌrʊm tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 它豎得像教室裡的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There must be a button for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr mʌst bi ə ˈbʌtən fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 一定有按鈕可以調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew showed me, on the armrest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru ʃoʊd mi, ɑn ði ˈɑrmˌrɛst./
dialogue.zh: 空服員剛指給我看，在扶手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we fix the seats next.
dialogue.zh: 那我們下一步先調整座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, one more sip of water.
dialogue.zh: 先讓我再喝一口水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, my cup is still half full.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, maɪ kʌp ɪz stɪl hæf fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 給，我這杯還有一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I was down to the last drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪ wʌz daʊn tə ðə læst drɑp./
dialogue.zh: 謝了，我這杯正好只剩最後一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many small things for one sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni smɔl θɪŋz fɔr wʌn slip./
dialogue.zh: 為了睡一覺，準備了好多小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix the seat first, then we rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪks ðə sit fɜrst, ðɛn wi rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 先把椅子調好，再來睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to lean back, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə lin bæk, ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我想往後靠，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, the seat behind has space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, ðə sit bɪˈhaɪnd hæz speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你躺吧，後面那位還有空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His tray table is still up.
dialogue.zh: 他的桌板還收在原地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So his knees have room to move.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɪz niz hæv rum tə muv./
dialogue.zh: 所以他的膝蓋還能動一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I press this button here.
dialogue.zh: 那我按這裡的按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy now, my cup is still out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi naʊ, maɪ kʌp ɪz stɪl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，我的杯子還擺在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happens, is it locked?
dialogue.zh: 沒動啊，是不是卡住了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must hold it down, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mʌst hoʊld ɪt daʊn, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想你要一直壓著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, it moved back a little.
dialogue.zh: 有了，它往後倒了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More, please, my neck needs it.
dialogue.zh: 再下來一點，我的脖子需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All the way is too much for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðə weɪ ɪz tu mʌtʃ fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 完全躺平對我來說太誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The man behind just nodded okay.
dialogue.zh: 後面那位先生點了點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a second button, look.
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有第二個按鈕，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one lifts your leg rest.
dialogue.zh: 那個是抬腳的踏板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my legs are up in the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ʌp ɪn ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 現在我的腿高高抬起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine stays down, it is stuck.
dialogue.zh: 我這個卡住了，抬不起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the crew, they fix those.
dialogue.zh: 跟空服員說一聲，他們會處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later, now I only want sleep.
dialogue.zh: 等一下再說，我現在只想睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet have nowhere to go.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳沒地方放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your bag flat on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt jɔr bæɡ flæt ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 把包包平放在地板上墊腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my feet rest on the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ fit rɛst ɑn ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那我的腳就擱在包上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A footrest made of your suitcase.
dialogue.zh: 你的行李箱變成腳踏板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better than that metal ledge.
dialogue.zh: 比那個金屬小平台好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ledge is for the tray, silly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛdʒ ɪz fɔr ðə treɪ, ˈsɪli./
dialogue.zh: 那個平台是放餐盤的，笨蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what is that little shelf for?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ɪz ðæt ˈlɪtəl ʃɛlf fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 那那個小板子是幹嘛用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it down, then it is a table.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt daʊn, ðɛn ɪt ɪz ə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 把它拉下來就是一張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It clicks and stops, see?
dialogue.zh: 喀一聲就卡住了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wobbly, but my cup can sit.
dialogue.zh: 有點晃，不過杯子放得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I slip these shoes off?
dialogue.zh: 我可以先把這雙鞋脫掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep them under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt kip ðɛm ˈʌndər ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但鞋子要收在座位下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not in the aisle, someone trips.
dialogue.zh: 不能擺在走道，會有人被絆倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, feet in the aisle are rude.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, fit ɪn ði ˈaɪl ɑr rud./
dialogue.zh: 就是啊，腳伸在走道很不禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are my soft plane slippers.
dialogue.zh: 這是我帶來的飛機拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine are just the socks with grips.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɑr dʒʌst ðə sɑks wɪð ɡrɪps./
dialogue.zh: 我只有那種帶防滑條的襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grips, so I do not slide down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrɪps, soʊ aɪ du nɑt slaɪd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 有防滑就不會一直往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My socks leave lines on my skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑks liv laɪnz ɑn maɪ skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 襪子在我腳上壓出一條條痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These shoes were tight all day.
dialogue.zh: 這雙鞋一整天都緊緊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By morning your feet will feel like wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ jɔr fit wɪl fil laɪk wʊd./
dialogue.zh: 到天亮的時候，腳會硬得像木板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, my foot is twice the size.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, maɪ fʊt ɪz twaɪs ðə saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，我的腳腫了一倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours does that to you.
dialogue.zh: 飛十三個小時誰都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This headrest has folding wings.
dialogue.zh: 這個頭枕兩邊可以摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push them in, my head stays up.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðɛm ɪn, maɪ hɛd steɪz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 把兩側摺進來，頭就不會歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine falls sideways every time.
dialogue.zh: 我的頭每次都會往旁邊垂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll a blanket around your neck.
dialogue.zh: 把毯子捲一圈圍住脖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like a soft collar, clever.
dialogue.zh: 像一個軟領子，這招聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or pull your hoodie up high.
dialogue.zh: 不然就把連帽衫的帽子拉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hood has no string to tie.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hʊd hæz noʊ strɪŋ tə taɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的帽子沒有繩子可以束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lean on the window frame.
dialogue.zh: 那就靠在窗邊的框框上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold glass against my sleepy cheek.
dialogue.zh: 冰涼的窗玻璃貼著我快睡著的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a pillow there, between you two.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ə ˈpɪloʊ ðɛr, bɪˈtwin ju tu./
dialogue.zh: 在那中間塞個枕頭，別讓臉直接貼著窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the shade, the light hurts.
dialogue.zh: 把遮光板關起來，光好刺眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It slides down with a small click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt slaɪdz daʊn wɪð ə smɔl klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 它往下一壓，喀一聲就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it is dark on my side.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ɪz dɑrk ɑn maɪ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我這一邊現在全黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, no light near me.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊也是，附近一點光都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the reading light off, okay?
dialogue.zh: 閱讀燈就讓它關著，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, mine is still on. Oops.
dialogue.zh: 等等，我這盞還亮著，糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it twice and it dies.
dialogue.zh: 按兩下它就全滅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down to nothing, dark as a cave.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn tə ˈnʌθɪŋ, dɑrk æz ə keɪv./
dialogue.zh: 一點光都不剩，黑得像山洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the belt over your blanket.
dialogue.zh: 把安全帶拉在毯子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So she can find the clip fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃi kæn faɪnd ðə klɪp fæst./
dialogue.zh: 這樣她一下就摸到扣環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clever trick, I will do that.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，我也照樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the wake-up needs no words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə weɪk ʌp nidz noʊ wɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 叫起床時連話都不用講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pillow behind my lower back.
dialogue.zh: 一個枕頭塞在我的下背後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My coat works as a back rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ koʊt wɜrks æz ə bæk rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我的外套剛好當腰靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not slide forward while you sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt slaɪd ˈfɔrwərd waɪl ju slip./
dialogue.zh: 睡著時別一直往前滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The belt holds me, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt hoʊldz mi, du nɑt ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 有安全帶拉著，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your chair is now a small bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr tʃɛr ɪz naʊ ə smɔl bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你這張椅子現在是一張小床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stiff bed, but it is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɪf bɛd, bʌt ɪt ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 硬邦邦的小床，不過是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your seat now, comfy?
dialogue.zh: 你現在坐著還舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine out of ten, minus the shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn aʊt ʌv tɛn, ˈmɪnəs ðə ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 九十分，扣分在沒鞋穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten would need a real mattress.
dialogue.zh: 要滿分得有一張真正的床墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On a plane? No chance at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ə pleɪn? noʊ tʃæns ət ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 在飛機上？根本沒機會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the door, the light went down.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr, ðə laɪt wɛnt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 門口那盞燈剛剛調暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the cabin wants us asleep.
dialogue.zh: 那就是艙內要我們睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost ready, one last thing.
dialogue.zh: 快弄好了，最後一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray up, and the latch clicked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ʌp, ænd ðə lætʃ klɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 桌板收起來，扣環喀一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is face down now.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機現在面朝下放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silent too, no light from it.
dialogue.zh: 也關成無聲，才不會亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your air knob is set on low.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ɛr nɑb ɪz sɛt ɑn loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你頭上的風開在最小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it, my nose gets cold.
dialogue.zh: 關小一點，我的鼻子會冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you snore? Be honest now.
dialogue.zh: 你會打呼嗎？現在老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, sorry in advance.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，先跟你說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have plugs, so no problem.
dialogue.zh: 我有耳塞，所以完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will snore like a bear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ wɪl snɔr laɪk ə bɛr./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就放心打得像隻熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both my feet are under now.
dialogue.zh: 我的兩隻腳都蓋進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine slipped down on the floor.
dialogue.zh: 我的那條滑到地板上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave it, pick it up at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt, pɪk ɪt ʌp æt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 先別管，六點再撿就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At six thirty, yes, doctor.
dialogue.zh: 六點半，遵命，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am the one who slept first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ðə wʌn hu slɛpt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先睡著的人是我喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sleep, I will watch the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn slip, aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那你睡吧，我幫你顧著燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a lamp on the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə læmp ɑn ðə kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 餐車上面那盞燈亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dinner is here, right on time.
dialogue.zh: 晚餐來了，剛好按時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So much work on my seat, for nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ mʌtʃ wɜrk ɑn maɪ sit, fɔr ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 椅子弄了半天，白弄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not nothing, you can lie back now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈnʌθɪŋ, ju kæn laɪ bæk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 才不白弄，你現在能躺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a bed on a night plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə bɛd ɑn ə naɪt pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 夜航飛機上半張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A moving bed with a small window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmuvɪŋ bɛd wɪð ə smɔl ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 會動的床，還附一個小窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing but hum and soft seat.
dialogue.zh: 只剩下嗡嗡聲和軟軟的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hush now, I am almost gone.
dialogue.zh: 噓，我快要睡過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake me if the light comes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪk mi ɪf ðə laɪt kʌmz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 如果燈又亮了就叫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep first, we still have dinner.
dialogue.zh: 你先睡，晚餐還得撐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the dinner cart, wow.
dialogue.zh: 晚餐的餐車來了，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We made the bed five minutes ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪd ðə bɛd faɪv ˈmɪnɪts əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們五分鐘前才剛把床鋪好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the tray down, then eat.
dialogue.zh: 把桌板拉下來，然後開吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat in the dark? That is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /it ɪn ðə dɑrk? ðæt ɪz nu./
dialogue.zh: 在黑黑的裡面吃？這倒新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says we can keep the mask on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz wi kæn kip ðə mæsk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 她說眼罩可以不用摘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not with noodles in front of me.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wɪð ˈnudlz ɪn frʌnt ʌv mi./
dialogue.zh: 可是麵擺在眼前，我還是要看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did she offer, chicken or fish?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ʃi ˈɔfər, ˈtʃɪkən ɔr fɪʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 她提供什麼，雞肉還是魚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicken rice, or noodles with vegetables.
dialogue.zh: 雞肉飯，或是蔬菜麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will have the chicken, please.
dialogue.zh: 那我要雞肉飯，麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noodles for me, with vegetables.
dialogue.zh: 我要蔬菜麵就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You chose sleep over dinner, remember?
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛說睡覺比晚餐要緊，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The smell reached me, it is my fault.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl ritʃt mi, ɪt ɪz maɪ fɔlt./
dialogue.zh: 是香味先找到我的，算我的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dinners, and two waters too.
dialogue.zh: 兩份晚餐，還有兩杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No juice for me, sugar keeps me up.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒus fɔr mi, ˈʃʊɡər kips mi ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我不要果汁，糖分會讓我清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked about coffee and tea.
dialogue.zh: 她問要不要咖啡或茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say no coffee tonight, please.
dialogue.zh: 跟她說今晚不要咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one green tea for me.
dialogue.zh: 再來一杯綠茶給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is smart, warm and no caffeine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz smɑrt, wɔrm ænd noʊ kæˈfin./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，溫熱又沒有咖啡因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it comes, the hot tray.
dialogue.zh: 來了來了，熱騰騰的餐盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lid has steam, look.
dialogue.zh: 蓋子上面全是蒸氣，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chicken rice, it smells like home.
dialogue.zh: 雞肉飯，聞起來像家裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is noodles, long and soft.
dialogue.zh: 我的麵又長又軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bowl too hot to hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə boʊl tu hɑt tə hoʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 碗燙到拿不住了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the napkin, like a glove.
dialogue.zh: 用餐巾紙墊著，就像手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My spoon fell under the seat.
dialogue.zh: 我的湯匙掉到座位底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use my fork, I have two.
dialogue.zh: 用我的叉子，我這邊有兩支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tray is small, everything shakes.
dialogue.zh: 這桌板太小了，什麼都在晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it all the way in, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt ɔl ðə weɪ ɪn, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 把它推到最裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bread came in a tiny bag.
dialogue.zh: 麵包裝在一個小袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter is on the side, see?
dialogue.zh: 奶油在旁邊的小格，看見沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rolls, one for later.
dialogue.zh: 兩顆小圓包，留一顆待會兒吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it for the morning hunger.
dialogue.zh: 留著早上餓的時候吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your noodles are getting cold.
dialogue.zh: 你的麵要涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat them fast, they are the best.
dialogue.phonetic: /it ðɛm fæst, ðeɪ ɑr ðə bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 快吃，那個麵最好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chicken is a little dry.
dialogue.zh: 這雞肉有那麼一點乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the sauce, the small white one.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə sɔs, ðə smɔl waɪt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 加那個醬，小白盒的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you hide that sauce?
dialogue.zh: 你把醬藏到哪兒去了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the bread, look there.
dialogue.zh: 在麵包下面，你看那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You plan a meal like a game.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plæn ə mil laɪk ə ɡeɪm./
dialogue.zh: 你吃個飯像在佈陣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winning tastes better, eat up.
dialogue.zh: 贏了比較好吃，快吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half my rice is gone already.
dialogue.zh: 我飯都吃掉一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down, we have ten more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn, wi hæv tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，還有十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Behind us, that man is still eating.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs, ðæt mæn ɪz stɪl ˈitɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們後面那位還在吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asked for a second bread roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æskt fɔr ə ˈsɛkənd brɛd roʊl./
dialogue.zh: 他多要了一顆麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have one more water cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hæv wʌn mɔr ˈwɔtər kʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再來一杯水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She refills, just leave the cup out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi riˈfɪlz, dʒʌst liv ðə kʌp aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 她會一直加，把杯子放外面就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lips are dry from the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪps ɑr draɪ frʌm ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇被吹得好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lip balm is in my side pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪp bɑm ɪz ɪn maɪ saɪd ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 護唇膏在我側面的口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that thing saves me.
dialogue.zh: 謝了，那東西救了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink the whole cup, not half.
dialogue.zh: 整杯喝光，別只喝一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a cookie on your tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ˈkʊki ɑn jɔr treɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你盤上那是餅乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two small ones, take one now.
dialogue.zh: 兩片小的，你先拿一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With tea? Perfect, I am happy.
dialogue.zh: 配茶？太完美，我好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crumbs everywhere, on my blanket.
dialogue.zh: 碎屑掉得到處都是，毯子上也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brush them off before lights out.
dialogue.zh: 關燈之前先把它們拍掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it is clean again.
dialogue.zh: 好了，毯子又乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Such a tiny cup of tea.
dialogue.zh: 這杯茶也太小杯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three sips, and then it is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri sɪps, ænd ðɛn ɪt ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 三口就見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm liquid, then sleep, right?
dialogue.zh: 喝點溫的，再來睡覺，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and no more screen light.
dialogue.zh: 對，而且不再看發光的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the trays when you are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə treɪz wɛn ju ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 吃完就把餐盤收走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She waits, I will hand them over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪts, aɪ wɪl hænd ðɛm ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 她在旁邊等，我遞過去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fork, spoon, napkin, all in.
dialogue.zh: 叉子、湯匙、紙巾，全部收進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bag, and the seat is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bæɡ, ænd ðə sit ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 再塞進袋子，座位就空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep these two cups?
dialogue.zh: 這兩杯水我們可以留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says yes, take both cups.
dialogue.zh: 她說可以，兩杯都留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peanuts too? She has a small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpinʌts tu? ʃi hæz ə smɔl bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 還有花生？她有一小包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them, salt makes me thirsty.
dialogue.zh: 你拿去，鹽吃多了會渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, then I need more water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl, ðɛn aɪ nid mɔr ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，那我得多喝一點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second blanket finally came.
dialogue.zh: 第二條毯子終於送來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two layers, now it is a bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈleɪərz, naʊ ɪt ɪz ə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 兩層疊起來，真的是床了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bed with a food smell, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛd wɪð ə fud smɛl, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過是一張有飯菜味的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whole cabin smells like a canteen.
dialogue.zh: 整個機艙聞起來像自助餐廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open your shade, get some air.
dialogue.zh: 把遮光板開一下，透透氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it is cold beyond that glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt ɪz koʊld bɪˈjɑnd ðæt ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 不了，那玻璃外面冷得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the fan, just a tiny bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə fæn, dʒʌst ə ˈtaɪni bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就開小風，一點點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It moves the food smell away.
dialogue.zh: 風把飯味吹走一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but my cookie is gone.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，我的餅乾也吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes close while I chew.
dialogue.zh: 我嚼著嚼著眼睛就閉起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, I ate two bites asleep.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，有兩口是睡著吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You barely ate your noodles.
dialogue.zh: 你的麵根本沒吃幾口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half left, for the morning.
dialogue.zh: 留了一半，早上餓再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe your mouth, then rest.
dialogue.zh: 擦擦嘴，然後就躺著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The warm towel again, please.
dialogue.zh: 拜託再給一條熱毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She brings one, she thinks of everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi brɪŋz wʌn, ʃi θɪŋks ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她真的又拿了一條，她想得很周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the whole cabin is quiet.
dialogue.zh: 現在整個機艙安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chair up, tray back, drink gone.
dialogue.zh: 椅子靠好，桌板收起來，飲料喝光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, I am ready to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, aɪ æm ˈrɛdi tə slip./
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣，準備要睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more sip of water first.
dialogue.zh: 先讓我再喝最後一口水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the mask goes on your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə mæsk ɡoʊz ɑn jɔr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 然後眼罩就往眼睛蓋下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the cart went up the row.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə kɑrt wɛnt ʌp ðə roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，餐車已經走到前面那排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the lights just went lower.
dialogue.zh: 燈也剛好再調暗一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect time for my earplugs.
dialogue.zh: 現在正是塞耳塞的時機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll them thin, remember how?
dialogue.zh: 把它搓細再塞，還記得怎麼做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes past one, wow.
dialogue.zh: 一點十二分了，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time flew while we built a bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm flu waɪl wi bɪlt ə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 床鋪一鋪，時間就飛走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost two hours gone already.
dialogue.zh: 起飛到現在快兩小時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About eleven hours till landing.
dialogue.zh: 大約還有十一個小時落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So close your eyes, eleven hours.
dialogue.zh: 那就閉眼吧，十一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mask on, plugs in, I am gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæsk ɑn, plʌɡz ɪn, aɪ æm ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 眼罩戴好、耳塞塞好，我就走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the whole cabin is dark.
dialogue.zh: 現在整個機艙都黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the floor lights stay on.
dialogue.zh: 只有地板那排小燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue lines down the middle.
dialogue.zh: 走道中間是一條條藍色光線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They show us the way to walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃoʊ ʌs ðə weɪ tə wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 那是要告訴我們怎麼走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again with the seatbelt sign, great.
dialogue.zh: 繫安全帶的燈又亮了，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no standing, just sitting still.
dialogue.zh: 所以不能站起來，只能坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is one twenty, my watch says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌn ˈtwɛnti, maɪ wɑtʃ sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 我錶上是一點二十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your watch lies, it is later.
dialogue.zh: 你的錶亂說，其實更晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Engine hum sounds softer now.
dialogue.zh: 引擎的轟鳴聲聽起來變軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are high up, that is why.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr haɪ ʌp, ðæt ɪz waɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們飛得高了，所以才這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the free earphones, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把那副免費耳機遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the pocket, in a small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈpɑkɪt, ɪn ə smɔl bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在椅背袋裡，小小一個包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two white buds, a thin wire.
dialogue.zh: 兩個白色耳塞，一條細線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plug is the small round kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plʌɡ ɪz ðə smɔl raʊnd kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 插頭是小圓頭那一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the hole for it?
dialogue.zh: 插孔在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the seat, near your foot.
dialogue.zh: 在座椅下方，靠近你的腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found it, it is dark there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ɪt, ɪt ɪz dɑrk ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我摸到了，那下面黑黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel with two fingers, left a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil wɪð tu ˈfɪŋɡərz, lɛft ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 用兩根手指往左邊摸一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the wire is in now.
dialogue.zh: 進去了，線已經插上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which side is yours? Mine is left.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ɪz jʊrz? maɪn ɪz lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 你那一邊是哪邊？我的在左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One short wire, so stay still.
dialogue.zh: 線只有一小段，所以別亂動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not pull it, it will slip out.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊl ɪt, ɪt wɪl slɪp aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 別扯到它，一扯就掉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I play for sleep?
dialogue.zh: 我該放什麼來助眠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain sounds, no words in them.
dialogue.zh: 雨聲那種，裡面沒有歌詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one, a white noise list.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn, ə waɪt nɔɪz lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 我有一份白噪音的播放清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play it low, the cabin is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪ ɪt loʊ, ðə ˈkæbən ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 小聲放就好，艙裡本來就靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the volume, no more.
dialogue.zh: 音量開一半，不能再大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bar less, like that.
dialogue.zh: 再降一格，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I hear rain and hum.
dialogue.zh: 現在我聽到雨聲和引擎聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a tin roof in soft rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ə tɪn ruf ɪn sɔft reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 像下小雨時鐵皮屋頂的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fan track is my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 那個風扇聲的音軌是我的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hides the snoring behind us.
dialogue.zh: 它剛好蓋掉後面那位的打呼聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is at forty percent.
dialogue.zh: 我手機只剩四成的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then plug it in, there is a port.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn plʌɡ ɪt ɪn, ðɛr ɪz ə pɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 那就插電，座位下面有插孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the seat, you mean?
dialogue.zh: 你是說座椅下面那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring the cord, it is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, brɪŋ ðə kɔrd, ɪt ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 對，線拉過來，它很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cable is the small kind.
dialogue.zh: 我的傳輸線是小頭的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits, see? Charge it two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts, si? tʃɑrdʒ ɪt tu ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 插進去了，看？充兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not play video on it.
dialogue.zh: 別用手機看影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No screen at all, promise.
dialogue.zh: 我完全不碰螢幕，答應你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the phone face down flat.
dialogue.zh: 把手機面朝下平平放著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the seat pocket, out of light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə sit ˈpɑkɪt, aʊt ʌv laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 放進椅背袋，就不會透光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Airplane mode, did you do it?
dialogue.zh: 飛行模式開了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I checked twice, no calls now.
dialogue.zh: 我確認兩次了，現在不會有電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brightness down to the last bar.
dialogue.zh: 亮度調到最低那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is off, I use no light.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz ɔf, aɪ juz noʊ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的整個關掉，不需要光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Earbud wire went behind my neck.
dialogue.zh: 耳機線跑到我脖子後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck it under the blanket edge.
dialogue.zh: 把它塞進毯子邊緣裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus, the mask strap pushes the buds.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs, ðə mæsk stræp pʊʃəz ðə bʌdz./
dialogue.zh: 再加上眼罩的帶子會壓到耳塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear the buds over your ear top.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ðə bʌdz ˈoʊvər jɔr ɪr tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 把線繞到耳朵上方就不會痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, now nothing pulls.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，都不會被扯到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the rain is back in both ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə reɪn ɪz bæk ɪn boʊθ ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 雨聲也回到兩個耳朵裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will count my breaths, slow.
dialogue.zh: 我來數自己的呼吸，慢慢數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To forty, that is the trick.
dialogue.zh: 數到四十，那就是訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four counts pulling in, six pushing out.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr kaʊnts ˈpʊlɪŋ ɪn, sɪks ˈpʊʃɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 吸進四拍，再慢慢吐到六拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tried it, it works too well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ traɪd ɪt, ɪt wɜrks tu wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我試過，有效得有過之。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too good and we miss the landing.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɡʊd ænd wi mɪs ðə ˈlændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 太有效會讓我們錯過降落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew wakes us, remember that.
dialogue.zh: 空服員會叫我們，記得嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, no alarm, just their hand.
dialogue.zh: 對，不設鬧鐘，只靠她的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a small shake, very gentle.
dialogue.zh: 再加一下輕輕的搖，很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes burn behind the mask.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛在眼罩後面發燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry air, that is why we drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɛr, ðæt ɪz waɪ wi drɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 空氣太乾，所以才要一直喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drank two cups, believe me.
dialogue.zh: 我已經喝了兩杯了，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you will wake up to pee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju wɪl weɪk ʌp tə pi./
dialogue.zh: 那你半夜一定會起來上廁所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, exactly what I want.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，正是我想要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laugh now, at three you will crawl.
dialogue.phonetic: /læf naʊ, æt θri ju wɪl krɔl./
dialogue.zh: 現在先別笑，三點你就會爬過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air vent blowing right on my face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr vɛnt bloʊɪŋ raɪt ɑn maɪ feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 出風口正對著我的臉吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it to the window side.
dialogue.zh: 把它轉向靠窗那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which little wheel? Oh, I got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈlɪtəl wil? oʊ, aɪ ɡɑt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 哪個小轉盤？噢，我會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, now it blows my hair.
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在風在吹我的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softly, I am trying to sleep.
dialogue.zh: 小聲點，我在試著睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, back to the dark now.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，不鬧了，回到黑黑的裡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your mask on straight?
dialogue.zh: 你的眼罩戴正了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crooked already, let me fix it.
dialogue.zh: 已經歪了，我來調整一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull it down to your cheek line.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt daʊn tə jɔr tʃik laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 往下拉到頰骨那一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, no light from the top.
dialogue.zh: 可以了，上面不會漏光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Belt over blanket, yes.
dialogue.zh: 很好。安全帶壓在毯子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, I look like a wrapped gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, aɪ lʊk laɪk ə ræpt ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 弄好了，我像一個包好的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This gift is already snoring.
dialogue.zh: 這個禮物已經開始打呼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the man behind, not me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə mæn bɪˈhaɪnd, nɑt mi./
dialogue.zh: 那是後面那位，不是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same sound, twice as loud.
dialogue.zh: 一樣的聲音，不過大了兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plug one ear, keep one for calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ wʌn ɪr, kip wʌn fɔr kɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 塞一隻耳朵就好，另一隻留著聽通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up front, the speaker just clicked.
dialogue.zh: 前面的廣播剛剛喀了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the pilot saying good night.
dialogue.zh: 只是機長在說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he say anything useful?
dialogue.zh: 他講了什麼有用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Something about smooth air, I think.
dialogue.zh: 好像說前面氣流很平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we can sleep without shaking.
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以睡得不晃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until six fifteen, then the lights.
dialogue.zh: 到六點十五分為止，然後開燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty more minutes, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 再撐二十分鐘就睡，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You promised that an hour ago.
dialogue.zh: 你一個小時前就這樣答應我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shhh, the rain track is starting.
dialogue.zh: 噓，雨聲那首開始播放了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear it, and I am gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ɪt, ænd aɪ æm ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 我聽見了，然後就睡過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did you take off your glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dɪd ju teɪk ɔf jɔr ˈɡlæsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你的眼鏡摘下來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the hard case, by my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɑrd keɪs, baɪ maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 收在硬盒子裡，就在我包旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will not sit on them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ wɪl nɑt sɪt ɑn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 好，我才不會一屁股坐下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You would, you always move at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wʊd, ju ˈɔlˌweɪz muv æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你會的，你睡覺時一直亂動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven more hours of dark air.
dialogue.zh: 還有十一個小時的黑夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep, I will keep my eyes closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip, aɪ wɪl kip maɪ aɪz kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，我也會把眼睛閉好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm. My breathing already slowed.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的呼吸已經變慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will follow you down.
dialogue.zh: 好，我馬上跟著你一起睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm. What time is it now?
dialogue.zh: 嗯……現在幾點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No idea. The dark has no clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪˈdiə. ðə dɑrk hæz noʊ klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 不知道，黑漆漆的沒有鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says three thirty-eight.
dialogue.zh: 我手機顯示三點三十八分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three! Who is awake at three?
dialogue.zh: 三點！誰三點還醒著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me, I need the little room.
dialogue.zh: 我，我要去那個小房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lavatory, yes, go slow.
dialogue.zh: 洗手間啦，好，走慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the seatbelt sign off?
dialogue.zh: 繫安全帶的燈關掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can stand and walk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ju kæn stænd ænd wɔk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 關了，你現在可以站起來走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow the blue line, right?
dialogue.zh: 跟著那條藍色的線，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two rows forward, past the cart.
dialogue.zh: 往前兩排，經過餐車那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my blanket while I go.
dialogue.zh: 我走的時候幫我拿一下毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, take it, the floor is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, teɪk ɪt, ðə flɔr ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 不用，你自己帶著，地板冰冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone's shoe is in the aisle.
dialogue.zh: 有一雙鞋跑到走道上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kick it aside, do not trip.
dialogue.zh: 把它踢到旁邊，別被絆倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people wait by the door.
dialogue.zh: 有兩個人在門邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light is red, no room free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt ɪz rɛd, noʊ rum fri./
dialogue.zh: 燈是紅的，表示沒空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait, my legs are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn weɪt, maɪ lɛɡz ɑr faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我可以等，我的腿還沒酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front one is closer, see?
dialogue.zh: 前面那間比較近，你看到沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green light, one went in.
dialogue.zh: 變成綠燈了，有一間空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, the last one is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, ðə læst wʌn ɪz jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 等等，最後那間輪到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy door, and it swings wide.
dialogue.zh: 門好重，還會蕩來蕩去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push with your whole hand, slow.
dialogue.zh: 整隻手掌慢慢推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, the space is tiny.
dialogue.zh: 裡面空間小得離譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lock shows a green line.
dialogue.zh: 鎖好的時候會露出綠線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ow, the light hurts, so bright!
dialogue.zh: 哎唷，燈好刺眼，太亮了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover your eyes, then open slow.
dialogue.zh: 先遮一下眼睛，再慢慢張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My face looks white in the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ feɪs lʊks waɪt ɪn ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 鏡子裡的我的臉白白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look awake. Rub your cheeks.
dialogue.zh: 看起來挺清醒的，搓搓臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sink is the size of a hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sɪŋk ɪz ðə saɪz ʌv ə hænd./
dialogue.zh: 這個洗手台只有手掌大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water warm first, then cold.
dialogue.zh: 先熱水，再換冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water wakes the whole face.
dialogue.zh: 冷水一潑，整張臉都醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the paper, it is rough.
dialogue.zh: 用那張紙擦，比較粗但吸水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that flush was so loud.
dialogue.zh: 哇，剛剛沖水的聲音好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone hears it, I know.
dialogue.zh: 全艙的人都聽得到，我知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry if I woke you.
dialogue.zh: 如果我吵到你了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mask woke me, not you.
dialogue.zh: 是眼罩勒醒我的，不是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is standing up now.
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮現在全翹起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet it flat, use your hands.
dialogue.zh: 弄濕壓一壓，用手就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. The light is off now.
dialogue.zh: 好了，燈關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back slow, the row is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk sloʊ, ðə roʊ ɪz dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢回來，我們那排是全黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is twenty-three?
dialogue.zh: 二十三排是哪個方向？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left, then count two more rows.
dialogue.zh: 往左，再數兩排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost count at one row.
dialogue.zh: 我數到一排就忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the numbers on top.
dialogue.zh: 看行李架上面的排數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row twenty-two, so one more.
dialogue.zh: 二十二排，那再一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and our middle is free.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們中間那個位子還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the man behind move?
dialogue.zh: 後面那位先生動過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he sleeps like a rock.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他睡得像塊石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His snoring is my alarm.
dialogue.zh: 他的呼嚕聲就是我的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is the belt, it digs.
dialogue.zh: 我的是安全帶，勒進肉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our row, back again, phew.
dialogue.zh: 我們這排，又回來了，呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your blanket is on the floor.
dialogue.zh: 你的毯子已經在地板上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fell while I was gone.
dialogue.zh: 我不在的時候它滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick it up, the pillow too.
dialogue.zh: 撿起來吧，枕頭也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pillow was under the seat?
dialogue.zh: 我的枕頭跑到座位底下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your foot pushed it there.
dialogue.zh: 對啊，被你的腳踢過去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one earbud is missing.
dialogue.zh: 還有一顆耳機找不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel near the seat rail, low.
dialogue.zh: 摸摸座位下面的鐵軌旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, on my own bag.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，在我自己的包上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, the floor is gross.
dialogue.zh: 擦一下吧，地板很噁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gross is right at three a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡros ɪz raɪt æt θri ˌeɪ ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 三點鐘的地板一定很噁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, I will fix your mask.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn, aɪ wɪl fɪks jɔr mæsk./
dialogue.zh: 坐好，我幫你正一下眼罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose has a line on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz hæz ə laɪn ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的鼻子上被壓出一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the wire, it presses hard.
dialogue.zh: 是眼罩那條鐵絲壓的，它很硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need the little room too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ðə ˈlɪtəl rum tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你是不是也要去洗手間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my legs want a walk.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我的腿想走一走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go, the line is empty now.
dialogue.zh: 去吧，排隊的人剛剛走光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, not one more.
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘就回來，一分也不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the warm water cup too.
dialogue.zh: 把那杯溫水也帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew will pour me one.
dialogue.zh: 空服員會幫我再倒一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One time I chose the wrong row.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn taɪm aɪ tʃoʊz ðə rɔŋ roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 有一次我選錯了排數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-one again? Come back here.
dialogue.zh: 又是二十一排？快回到這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs know the way, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz noʊ ðə weɪ, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我的腿認得路，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, before you fall over.
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，免得整個人跌下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Help me find the belt clip.
dialogue.zh: 幫我用摸的找扣環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, over the blanket.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，就在毯子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart trick, the belt on top.
dialogue.zh: 這招真聰明，扣環放最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You thought of it, remember?
dialogue.zh: 是你想出來的，還記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought of many things tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚想出了超多對策。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now lie down, it is three forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ laɪ daʊn, ɪt ɪz θri ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 現在躺好，三點四十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine more hours till we land.
dialogue.zh: 還要九個小時才落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sleep all nine of them.
dialogue.zh: 那就把九個小時全部睡光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain track is still playing, see.
dialogue.zh: 雨聲那首還在播，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft and low, like before.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕小小的，跟剛剛一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are closing already.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛已經在閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not talk now, just breathe.
dialogue.zh: 現在別講話了，專心呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm. The plane rocks a bit.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，飛機在輕輕搖晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a bed that never stops.
dialogue.zh: 像一張永遠不會停的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake me for breakfast, please.
dialogue.zh: 早餐的時候記得叫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew will, I will just sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru wɪl, aɪ wɪl dʒʌst slip./
dialogue.zh: 空服員會叫的，我也要睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your glasses case fell again.
dialogue.zh: 你的眼鏡盒又掉下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shh, put it under your feet.
dialogue.zh: 噓，塞到你腳底下就不會掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Engines hum, and nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 只剩發動機在哼，沒有別的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our whole row is asleep.
dialogue.zh: 我們那一排全部睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck pillow slipped to the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nɛk ˈpɪloʊ slɪpt tu ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我的頸枕也滑到地板上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, do not move now.
dialogue.zh: 就放著吧，現在別動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Both eyes are shut now.
dialogue.zh: 好了，兩隻眼睛都閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the dark is back with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə dɑrk ɪz bæk wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 很好，黑暗又回到我們身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If you go again, take me.
dialogue.zh: 你如果再去，把我也帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more trips, nine hours of sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr trɪps, naɪn ˈaʊərz ʌv slip./
dialogue.zh: 不去了，我們要睡滿九小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I woke up and cannot go back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ woʊk ʌp ænd ˈkænɑt ɡoʊ bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我醒了，卻睡不回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me neither, my feet hurt.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我的腳好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five twenty by my watch.
dialogue.zh: 我錶上是五點二十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still dark, still humming.
dialogue.zh: 外面還是黑的，還是嗡嗡響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth all night, no shaking.
dialogue.zh: 一路飛得平穩，都沒有晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So why are we both awake?
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼我們兩個都醒著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are two sizes bigger.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳腫大兩個尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine feel like warm stones.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳摸起來像溫溫的石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See this? The sock left a ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs? ðə sɑk lɛft ə rɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你看這個，襪子在我腿上留了一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A red ring, all the way round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɛd rɪŋ, ɔl ðə weɪ raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 一圈紅紅的痕，繞著一整圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes will not go back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz wɪl nɑt ɡoʊ bæk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋穿不回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wiggle your heel, then push down.
dialogue.zh: 腳跟搖一搖，再往下踩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heel is stuck in the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hil ɪz stʌk ɪn ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳跟在半空中卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lace them loose, then slide in.
dialogue.zh: 鞋帶重新鬆鬆地繫，再滑進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, now they fit, barely.
dialogue.zh: 好了，穿得起來了，勉強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a mold of a bigger foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ə moʊld ʌv ə ˈbɪɡər fʊt./
dialogue.zh: 像幫更大的腳做的模型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my ring is tight today.
dialogue.zh: 連我手上的戒指都變緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers swell too, on long flights.
dialogue.zh: 長途飛行手指也會腫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need water, a long drink.
dialogue.zh: 我要喝水，好好喝一大口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your last cup is empty, look.
dialogue.zh: 你最後那杯水空了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished it at two, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt ɪt æt tu, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我兩點就把水喝完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the crew, she is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə kru, ʃi ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 去叫空服員，她就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three more cups, she says yes.
dialogue.zh: 她說可以再給三杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her no juice, no soda.
dialogue.zh: 跟她說不要果汁，也不要汽水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soda made me awake last time.
dialogue.zh: 上次喝汽水讓我睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sugar at night, never again.
dialogue.zh: 晚上攝取糖分，再也不要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those peanuts were so salty.
dialogue.zh: 那些花生鹹得過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why you are thirsty.
dialogue.zh: 所以你現在才這麼渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water, water, and more water.
dialogue.zh: 水、水，還要更多的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You say water like a song.
dialogue.zh: 你一直念水、水，像在唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will stand a minute, okay?
dialogue.zh: 我想站一分鐘，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sign is off, go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 燈熄了，你站起來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the seat in front of me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə sit ɪn frʌnt ʌv mi./
dialogue.zh: 我扶著前面那張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, the floor moves under me.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，地板在我腳下會動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, ten counts, then rest.
dialogue.zh: 一、二，數到十，再休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll your ankles, left then right.
dialogue.zh: 腳踝轉一轉，先左再右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My calves are tight as rope.
dialogue.zh: 我的小腿緊得像繩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push your toes up, hold it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ jɔr toʊz ʌp, hoʊld ɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 腳趾往上翹，撐在那裡別放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This helps, my calf is letting go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs hɛlps, maɪ kæf ɪz ˈlɛtɪŋ ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 有幫助，我的小腿鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down before you fall down.
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，免得整個人跌下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One stretch every two hours.
dialogue.zh: 每兩個小時拉筋一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew says that too, I heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru sɛz ðæt tu, aɪ hɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 空服員也是這樣說，我聽到過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the time zone pills?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju brɪŋ ðə taɪm zoʊn pɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 你有帶調時差的藥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my bag, two small white ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ bæɡ, tu smɔl waɪt wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 在我包裡，兩顆白色小藥錠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pill, the night we land.
dialogue.zh: 落地那天晚上，吃一顆就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not on the plane, at nine there.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn ðə pleɪn, æt naɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 不是在飛機上吃，是當地九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine there is three at home.
dialogue.zh: 那邊九點，等於台北凌晨三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, six hours back, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɪks ˈaʊərz bæk, ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 對，往回六小時，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the pill starts a new night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə pɪl stɑrts ə nu naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以那顆藥幫我們重新開始一個夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With water, not with juice.
dialogue.zh: 要配水喝，不能用果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I swallow pills like candy.
dialogue.zh: 我吞藥錠像在吃糖果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not make it a habit.
dialogue.zh: 別讓它變成一種習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One night, then we are on their time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn naɪt, ðɛn wi ɑr ɑn ðɛr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 撐過一個晚上，就改成他們的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
