dialogue.text: Two days, that is the real work.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz, ðæt ɪz ðə ril wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 要兩天，那才是真正的功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat is dry paper.
dialogue.zh: 我的喉嚨像乾紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swallow, then sip, then sleep.
dialogue.zh: 吞一下，小口喝，然後睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose is dry inside too.
dialogue.zh: 我鼻子裡面也乾乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The air up here is desert air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ʌp hɪr ɪz dɛzərt ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 高空的空氣乾得像沙漠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lip balm, and the cream for hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪp bɑm, ænd ðə krim fɔr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 護唇膏，還有護手霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You smell like a bathroom shelf.
dialogue.zh: 你聞起來像洗手台上的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A nice bathroom, with good soap.
dialogue.zh: 是間乾淨的洗手間，還有好香皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your chin has a blanket line.
dialogue.zh: 你的下巴上有一道毯子的印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And your nose has a mask line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr noʊz hæz ə mæsk laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你鼻子上還有眼罩的印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are both printed by a plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr boʊθ ˈprɪntɪd baɪ ə pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們都被飛機蓋了章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is a bird nest now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr ɪz ə bɜrd nɛst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮現在像鳥巢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just comb it with your fingers.
dialogue.zh: 就用手指當梳子梳一梳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water came, three more cups.
dialogue.zh: 水送來了，整整三杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One on the tray, one by your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɑn ðə treɪ, wʌn baɪ jɔr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 一杯放托盤，一杯給你拿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last cup, that is for the pill.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst kʌp, ðæt ɪz fɔr ðə pɪl./
dialogue.zh: 最後一杯留著配藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it for the night there.
dialogue.zh: 留到當地的晚上再喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put your feet up again, high.
dialogue.zh: 把腳再抬高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the bag, like before.
dialogue.zh: 擱在包上，像剛剛那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, the blood goes back down.
dialogue.zh: 舒服多了，血往回流了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why your legs go up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ jɔr lɛɡz ɡoʊ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 所以才要讓你的腿抬高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught you all these tricks?
dialogue.zh: 這些招數是誰教你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven night flights this year.
dialogue.zh: 今年飛了十一班紅眼航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the expert, professor.
dialogue.zh: 你是專家了，教授。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call me doctor, at five a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl mi ˈdɑktər, æt faɪv ˌeɪ ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 五點鐘就叫我醫生吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doctor, how much flight is left?
dialogue.zh: 醫生，還剩多少航程？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About seven hours, give or take.
dialogue.zh: 大約還有七個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is a whole school day.
dialogue.zh: 七個小時跟一整個上課日一樣久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A very quiet school, no talking.
dialogue.zh: 不過那學校很安靜，不能講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see? The light changed.
dialogue.zh: 你看到了嗎？燈色變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warmer, like before sunrise.
dialogue.zh: 變暖了，像日出之前那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a fake sun, on a timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə feɪk sʌn, ɑn ə ˈtaɪmər./
dialogue.zh: 那是假的日出燈光，有設定時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, so no one wakes angry.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢調亮，就不會有人被氣醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am not angry, just thirsty.
dialogue.zh: 我沒生氣，只是口渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then drink, and lie back down.
dialogue.zh: 那就喝，然後再躺回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain track stopped, look at that.
dialogue.zh: 雨聲停了，你瞧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone died, the battery.
dialogue.zh: 我手機沒電了，電池空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charge it, there is a port.
dialogue.zh: 充電吧，下面有插孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light feels warmer, that helps.
dialogue.zh: 燈光變暖了，這樣就有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, one more hour.
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼睛，再睡一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You first, doctor orders.
dialogue.zh: 你先睡，醫生的命令。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon they bring coffee up here.
dialogue.zh: 很快他們就會送咖啡上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not say coffee to me.
dialogue.zh: 別在我耳邊提咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You love coffee more than sleep.
dialogue.zh: 你愛咖啡勝過睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but tonight I choose sleep.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但今晚我選睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep, I will keep the pill safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip, aɪ wɪl kip ðə pɪl seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，我把那顆藥收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wake me at six, gently please.
dialogue.zh: 六點叫我，記得輕輕搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm. Six fifteen already?
dialogue.zh: 嗯……已經六點十五分了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew shook me, very gently.
dialogue.zh: 空服員輕輕搖我，動作很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mask left a red map.
dialogue.zh: 眼罩在我臉上留下紅紅的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On your face, both cheeks.
dialogue.zh: 你也是，兩個頰骨都紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time on my watch?
dialogue.zh: 我手上是幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve fifteen, Taipei time.
dialogue.zh: 十二點十五分，台北的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And here it is six fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 這裡已經是早上六點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hours back, like she said.
dialogue.zh: 往回六小時，跟她說的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We land in fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我們十五分鐘後降落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen! I still have crumbs.
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘！我手上還有餅乾屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm lights now, not white.
dialogue.zh: 燈是暖色的，不是白光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do that on purpose.
dialogue.zh: 他們是故意這樣調的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I snore all night?
dialogue.zh: 我打呼打了一整夜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and the man behind did too.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, ænd ðə mæn bɪˈhaɪnd dɪd tu./
dialogue.zh: 兩次，後面那位也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least I am not alone.
dialogue.zh: 至少我不是唯一一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit up slow, your back will hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ʌp sloʊ, jɔr bæk wɪl hɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢坐起來，不然是會腰痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck is made of stone.
dialogue.zh: 我的脖子硬得像石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it left, then right, slow.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉，先左後右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glasses. Where are my glasses?
dialogue.zh: 眼鏡，我的眼鏡呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the hard case, by your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɑrd keɪs, baɪ jɔr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在硬盒子裡，你包旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, the world is sharp again.
dialogue.zh: 啊，世界又變清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You slept through the dark part.
dialogue.zh: 黑的那一段你全睡過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seat up, tray in, please.
dialogue.zh: 椅背豎直，桌板收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is up, the latch clicked.
dialogue.zh: 我這個已經好了，喀一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the shade, careful, light!
dialogue.zh: 把遮光板打開，小心，光好強！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I opened it one inch.
dialogue.zh: 我只開了一指寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute, the light is strong.
dialogue.zh: 緩一分鐘，光太強了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blink slow, look at the floor.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢眨眼，先看地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now look out, what is that?
dialogue.zh: 現在往外看，那是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green fields, cut in squares.
dialogue.zh: 綠色的田，被切成一方方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are over land, at last.
dialogue.zh: 我們總算飛到陸地上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Windmills! Three of them, look.
dialogue.zh: 風車！三座，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real Dutch windmills, in the sun.
dialogue.zh: 真正的荷蘭風車，曬著太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And water lines between them.
dialogue.zh: 中間還有一條條運河。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wing looks frozen, it does not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪŋ lʊks ˈfroʊzən, ɪt dʌz nɑt muv./
dialogue.zh: 機翼看起來凍住了，完全沒有動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds us, steady as a table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ʌs, ˈstɛdi æz ə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 它把我們穩穩托住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look down, the wheels are out.
dialogue.zh: 往下看，起落架已經放出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I felt a small bump.
dialogue.zh: 我感覺輕輕一震。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seatbelt sign is back on.
dialogue.zh: 繫安全帶的燈又亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click yours, then rest your hands.
dialogue.zh: 扣好你的，手放著就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you get the coffee?
dialogue.zh: 你拿到咖啡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She left me a cup.
dialogue.zh: 她特別留了我一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still warm! You are the best.
dialogue.zh: 還是溫的！你太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black, no sugar, your usual order.
dialogue.zh: 黑咖啡不加糖，你慣常那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orange juice for me, please.
dialogue.zh: 那給我一杯橙汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a bread roll with jam.
dialogue.zh: 我這裡還有一顆麵包加果醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bread is warm inside.
dialogue.zh: 麵包裡面還暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jam sweet, coffee hot, perfect.
dialogue.zh: 果醬甜、咖啡燙，完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finish it, we are almost down.
dialogue.zh: 快吃完，我們就要落地了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bite, then the seatbelt.
dialogue.zh: 咬一口，再扣回安全帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She gave a warm towel too.
dialogue.zh: 她還給了一條熱毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands first, then the face.
dialogue.zh: 先擦手，再擦臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears popped on the way.
dialogue.zh: 下降的時候我耳朵悶住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swallow now, like this, see?
dialogue.zh: 現在吞一下，像我這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better. Did you bring gum?
dialogue.zh: 舒服點了。你有帶口香糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gave me two pieces.
dialogue.zh: 她給了我兩片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pilot is on the speaker again.
dialogue.zh: 機長又在廣播了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate twelve, and take your time.
dialogue.zh: 十二號艙口，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones still off, we wait.
dialogue.zh: 手機還不能開，再等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One minute, then all on.
dialogue.zh: 過一分鐘就可以開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We touched down, did you feel?
dialogue.zh: 我們觸地了，你感覺到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small bump, then the roar.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕一震，接著轟的一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the engines push us back.
dialogue.zh: 現在引擎往後推我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are slowing, feel it?
dialogue.zh: 在減速了，你感覺得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some people clap, always do.
dialogue.zh: 有人開始鼓掌，總是有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not clap, I am shy.
dialogue.zh: 別拍手，我會不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I clapped a little.
dialogue.zh: 我小小地拍了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You loved it, admit it.
dialogue.zh: 你其實很喜歡，承認吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours, we did it.
dialogue.zh: 十三個小時，我們撐完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine of them, we slept.
dialogue.zh: 其中九個小時在睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet fit on the floor.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳踩得到地板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still swollen, but they work.
dialogue.zh: 還是腫，但已經能走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is still under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz stɪl ˈʌndər ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 我的包還在座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your jacket, put it on.
dialogue.zh: 還有你的外套，穿上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is wet outside, look.
dialogue.zh: 外面是濕的，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain on the windows, yes.
dialogue.zh: 窗上有雨痕，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at that line, so long.
dialogue.zh: 你看那條隊伍好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sit, we are early.
dialogue.zh: 我們坐著就好，時間還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine tonight, the pill, remember.
dialogue.zh: 今晚九點吃那顆藥，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sleep at nine, new time.
dialogue.zh: 記得，當地的九點睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If we last that long.
dialogue.zh: 如果我們撐得到那個點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will, coffee helped.
dialogue.zh: 撐得住的，剛那杯咖啡有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck still knows the seat.
dialogue.zh: 我的脖子還記得椅背的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My cheek still has the line.
dialogue.zh: 我臉頰上還有那條壓痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes tight, socks soft.
dialogue.zh: 鞋子很緊，襪子很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry them, wear the slippers.
dialogue.zh: 把鞋拿在手上，穿拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mask goes in my pocket now.
dialogue.zh: 眼罩收進我的口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it out, for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 先別收，今晚還要戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet now, the engines stop.
dialogue.zh: 安靜了，引擎關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft hum, then nothing.
dialogue.zh: 最後一聲低鳴，然後全靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People stand, we wait.
dialogue.zh: 大家站起來了，我們再等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eyes half open, both of us.
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個眼睛都還半睜著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty on the ground.
dialogue.zh: 六點半，我們在地面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours in the sky.
dialogue.zh: 在天上飛了十三個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep came, in the end.
dialogue.zh: 到最後，我們真的睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real sleep, on a plane.
dialogue.zh: 在飛機上睡了真的一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon, the gate opens slow.
dialogue.zh: 很快艙門就會慢慢打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, five more minutes.
dialogue.zh: 還不行，再等五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your head, breathe out.
dialogue.zh: 靠著頭就好，慢慢吐氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mmm. Then we walk.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，然後我們才走下去。
